name: auto-session-title
description: Titles the session after a few prompts and refreshes it as the work drifts; /done and /undone add or remove a checkmark in front of the title.

firstTitleAtPrompt.title: First title at prompt
firstTitleAtPrompt.description: Give the session its first generated title once this many prompts have been sent. 0 turns automatic titles off.

refreshEveryPrompts.title: Refresh every N prompts
refreshEveryPrompts.description: Re-title the session this many prompts after the last automatic title, in case the work has moved on. 0 never refreshes.

maxAutoTitles.title: Stop after N automatic titles
maxAutoTitles.description: Stop titling a session on its own after this many automatic titles, so it isn't re-read forever. 2 is the first title plus one refresh; 1 titles once. 0 means no limit. /rename-session always works.

model.title: Title model
model.description: The model that writes the title. Titles are one short call, so a small model is plenty.

checkmark.title: Checkmark
checkmark.description: What /done puts in front of the title and /undone takes off.
